page_title: LAZ 1-1 BOL | Lazio v Bologna 07/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle and signals a foul after Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) brought his opponent down. A free kick is awarded to Lazio.
90+4' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
90+3' Juan Miranda (Bologna) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

90+3' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Juan Miranda (Bologna), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+1' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) commits a rough challenge and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul.
90+1' Juan Miranda (Bologna) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
87' The shots on goal statistics – 9:6.
84' Michael Fabbri shows a yellow card to Juan Miranda (Bologna) for a tough tackle.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Santiago Castro trots off the pitch and is replaced by Thijs Dallinga (Bologna).
80' Maurizio Sarri has decided to make a change. Patric (Lazio) replaces Toma Basic.
79' Was it necessary? Mario Gila (Lazio) is shown a second yellow card for dissent and has to leave the pitch. Michael Fabbri had no hesitation in issuing a red card!
78' Michael Fabbri shows a yellow card to Mario Gila (Lazio), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
78' CHANCE! Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) is coming onto the pitch as Danilo Cataldi cannot continue after picking up an injury.
74' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header to the top left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
74' There's an opportunity for Toma Basic (Lazio) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

73' A sweet pass finds Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Federico Ravaglia is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The referee blows his whistle, Lazio are awarded a corner kick.

72' Juan Miranda (Bologna) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Ivan Provedel was alert and the score remained the same.
71' The game is interrupted. Adam Marusic (Lazio) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
67' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) was quite harsh and Michael Fabbri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
65' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Nicolo Cambiaghi will be replaced by Jonathan Rowe (Bologna).
64' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Nikola Moro and he is replaced by Lewis Ferguson (Bologna).
64' Here comes a substitution. Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) is brought on as a substitute for Riccardo Orsolini.
63' A corner kick by Lazio is thwarted by the well prepared Federico Ravaglia (Bologna).

63' Federico Ravaglia makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) after a cross from the side. The ball goes out of play and Lazio have been awarded a corner kick.
63' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lazio comes to nothing.

63' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the bottom right corner, but Federico Ravaglia keeps it out with an amazing save. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lazio will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
59' A substitution has been made. Taty Castellanos is replaced by Tijjani Noslin (Lazio).
59' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
57' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Michael Fabbri signals.
55' Juan Miranda (Bologna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul.

52' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Federico Ravaglia makes a comfortable save.
51' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
49' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Michael Fabbri didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
47' Half-chance! Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) plays a pass into the box, but Federico Ravaglia reacts well to snuff out the attack.
46' Half-time substitution. Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) will not participate anymore and Matteo Cancellieri is coming on.
46' Maurizio Sarri has made a change at the break. Manuel Lazzari has come on in place of Nuno Tavares (Lazio).
46' Referee Michael Fabbri blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+3' Adam Marusic (Lazio) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
45+1' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Michael Fabbri stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Juan Miranda (Bologna) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety.
40' 1 - 1 Jens Odgaard (Bologna) is the lucky recipient of a rebound. He takes advantage of it and slots the ball low into the middle of the target, leaving the goalkeeper completely helpless.

40' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) suddenly has an opportunity to surge into the box after the opposition's defenders leave him in an ocean of space. He unleashes a decent shot towards the left side of the goal, but Ivan Provedel pulls off a fabulous save to deflect the ball onto the post.
39' Problems for Vincenzo Italiano as Nicolo Casale is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) replaces him.
38' 1 - 0 Goal! Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 1:0.

38' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, Federico Ravaglia anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
36' Nicolo Casale (Bologna) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
35' Toma Basic (Lazio) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
33' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Ivan Provedel gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
32' A cross from a corner kick by Lazio is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
31' Nikola Moro (Bologna) gets booked for the first time in this match.

30' It's unbelievable, Jens Odgaard (Bologna) blows a huge opportunity! He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific daisy-cutter from point blank range. His first-time effort is directed towards the middle of the target, but Ivan Provedel reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
29' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
28' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle after Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
25' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
24' A cross from a corner kick by Lazio is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

24' Toma Basic (Lazio) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Lazio get a corner.
22' Bologna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

21' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The ball is out of play. Bologna will have a chance to score from a corner.
20' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Nuno Tavares (Lazio) gets booked.
16' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Federico Ravaglia intercepts the ball.

15' Excellent touch by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
14' A clever short pass gives Jens Odgaard (Bologna) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post.

13' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Federico Ravaglia pulls off an easy save.
10' Michael Fabbri couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) and blew his whistle.
9' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle as Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
7' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
5' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
4' Nikola Moro (Bologna) makes a strong challenge and Michael Fabbri blows for a foul. Free kick. Lazio will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
3' Lazio take a short corner kick.

1' That was close by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Lazio will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Michael Fabbri.
